title: Support for React 19 and Next 15
body:
### 🐛 Current behavior

when I upgrade to React 19 and Nextjs 15 then Reacts-instantsearch-next.js and and react-instantsearch are not compatible which has proven true in that I can run them in dev but not able to deploy to production. These are the last two components in the way of me completing the upgrade: Here is the message:
You may have to update these packages to their latest version or file an issue to ask for support of the upgraded libraries.

react-instantsearch 7.13.9
├── ✕ unmet peer react@">= 16.8.0 < 19": found 19.0.0
└── ✕ unmet peer react-dom@">= 16.8.0 < 19": found 19.0.0
react-instantsearch-nextjs 0.3.20
└── ✕ unmet peer next@">= 13.4 < 15": found 15.1.2

Please review the local changes and read the Next.js 15 migration guide to complete the migration.
https://nextjs.org/docs/canary/app/building-your-application/upgrading/version-15

### 🔍 Steps to reproduce

i used the code mod npx @next/codemod@canary upgrade latest

### Live reproduction

https://ibikeride.com/search

### 💭 Expected behavior

I should be able to use both these components and deploy to production without compatibility errors as they are not supported on React 19
"react-instantsearch": "^7.13.9",
"react-instantsearch-nextjs": "^0.3.20",

### Package version

"react-instantsearch": "^7.13.9",   "react-instantsearch-nextjs": "^0.3.20",

### Operating system

macOS Sonata

### Browser

Microsoft Edge Version 131.0.2903.112 (Official build) (arm64)
